UsdGenCollide.caption: A sphere descends into 8,000 clumped strands, then slides across the patch. Collision bends against the outer subdivision limit; temporary shortening starts 0.15 stage units inside it and recovers as contact clears.
UsdGenCollide.provenance: Native usdGen cooked 8,000 strands with 18 CVs at each of 100 frames using cutThenCollide, flexible resolution, inset depth 0.15, blend depth 0.02, 128 iterations, pushAmount 1 and offset 0. Collision uses the Catmull-Clark Shield limit and the invisible closed ScalpVolume floor. All sequence geometry, root and clump metadata checks passed; 1,824 cleared-contact recovery controls returned to their incoming shape. Bounded temporal checks refined the strongest transition to eighth-frame steps. Flexible collision may change segment and total chord lengths. MoonRay rendered the accepted native BasisCurves; the 1,400-pixel hero shows frame 99.
UsdGenCollide.animationAlt: A sphere quickly descends into dense clumped fur, bending shallow contacts before deeper temporary shortening, then slides in Z as cleared fur recovers.
UsdGenCollide.animationProvenance: 100 distinct native MoonRay images show frames 0–99 at 24 fps. The shared-palette GIF preserves 100 encoded records and totals 4,170 ms. Independent native-frame renders verified the batch poses. The companion changes only Shield visibility; no fur geometry, material or animation is substituted.
